data_classification: synthetic demonstration only; department-level aggregates for Harbourline Imaging, a fictional Singapore imaging network across 5 planning areas; no patient data, images or report text

grains.RAW.DEPARTMENTS: one row per imaging department (40, across 5 Singapore planning areas)
grains.RAW.DEPT_DAILY: one row per department per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.SCANNER_FLEET: one row per department (scanner fleet snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day FORECAST of reports finalised in target; report turnaround ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.DEPT_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic radiology workflow SOPs (one per department type and delay driver)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.RADIOLOGY_OPS_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.RADIOLOGY_OPS_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, department, delay-driver and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (departments, daily studies and escalations, confirmed TAT breaches by department, breach risk, study events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_STUDIES
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_STUDY_ALERT logs new ALERT events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.breach_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(confirmed priority-study TAT breach in next 7 days) per department, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout; operational, not diagnostic or clinical

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
